ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an s-plane pole plot of a standard second-order system, with the horizontal axis as the real axis σ and the vertical axis as jω. The conjugate poles p and p* are located in the left half-plane and fall on the dashed circle centered at the origin with radius ω_n; θ indicates the angle between the negative real-axis direction and the pole radius line. According to the specified method, the damping ratio ζ=cosθ, and the settling time is approximately Ts≈4/(ζω_n). In System 1, ζ=cos60°=0.5, so ζω_n=0.5×3=1.5. In System 2, ζ=cos70°≈0.342, so ζω_n≈0.342×1=0.342. Since Ts is inversely proportional to ζω_n, System 2 has a smaller ζω_n, therefore System 2 has a larger settling time.
